task.title: android-collection-check probe still taps the hidden ± stepper buttons
task.description: Found during on-device verification of PR #168 (2026-08-20): end2end probe android-collection-check.mjs asserts a stepper tap on the ± button, but below the sm breakpoint those buttons are hidden (hidden sm:inline-flex) and the shipped affordance is tap-the-number-to-edit (count-stepper-value opens a native number input). The probe predates this and its stepper check now fails on-device while the product behavior is correct (verified via the /dev/components bench: editor opens, commit produces the undo toast, revert works). Update the probe to drive tap-to-edit. Note: authed pages remain unreachable over the Android dev attach (dev proxy strips Cookie headers, specs/ui-work-loop.md 2026-07-19), so probes must keep routing through the bench.
